coverage.description: Broad selection of current general, coding and reasoning LLM families with official local Ollama artifacts, plus useful small baselines and larger-host candidates. This is a researched selection, not an exhaustive quality ranking or every community fine-tune.
coverage.selection: Prefer explicit quantized GGUF tags; avoid latest aliases, MLX artifacts and cloud inference. Published sources were checked through 2026-10-21.
coverage.size_provenance: Registry pages publish rounded decimal sizes. Approximate sizes are not exact manifests; upper bounds add 15% plus 64 MiB. Live manifest checks are mandatory before downloading.
coverage.memory_provenance: All RAM figures and minimum host tiers are conservative planning estimates, not vendor guarantees or measurements on the two Macs.
coverage.safety_limitation: A JSON catalog cannot enforce limits or guarantee zero OOM. A consumer must implement every admission check, watchdog and cleanup rule; skip when required information is unavailable.

memory.resident_model_credit: For a request on an already loaded, run-owned model, replace budget in the available-memory comparison with max(0, budget - verified_owned_physical_footprint); do not relax the physical-memory cap or watchdog.
memory.formula: budget = ceil(model.resources.estimated_peak_unified_memory_bytes * estimate_multiplier); require physical >= minimum_physical_memory_bytes AND budget <= physical * maximum_physical_memory_fraction AND budget + os_reserve_bytes <= physical AND budget + minimum_available_after_admission_bytes <= available; apply resident_model_credit only for an already loaded owned model. If Metal recommended working set is available also require budget <= recommended_working_set * maximum_metal_working_set_fraction_if_reported.

disk.formula: payload = sum(config.size + every layer.size) from the resolved GGUF manifest; require payload <= model.resources.download_bytes_upper_bound. On the model-store volume reserve download_and_temporary_multiplier * download_bytes_upper_bound; add installer_budget_bytes on the installer volume and maximum_total_results_bytes on the results volume; add temporary payload allowance on a separate temporary volume if used. Aggregate charges for shared volumes. Every volume must have free >= charged_bytes + max(reserve_bytes, ceil(volume_total * reserve_volume_fraction)).

engine.modelfile_template:
FROM {ollama_tag}
PARAMETER num_ctx 2048
PARAMETER num_predict 256
PARAMETER num_batch 128
PARAMETER temperature 0
PARAMETER seed 42
notes: Spawn argv directly; placeholders are individual arguments, never interpolated into a shell command.
Use a unique run-owned alias and directory. The alias shares weights inside the isolated store; it does not duplicate the model download.
Apply environment to the owned server process, not only to the client. Never silently reuse the desktop app's daemon.
Use the installed Ollama version only after verifying the needed CLI flags, parameters and backend; no unverified minimum version is asserted.

benchmark.batch_definition: A fixed batch of independent CLI invocations executed sequentially with one resident model. num_batch is prompt-processing microbatch size, not request concurrency. Concurrent batching needs a separately budgeted future profile.
